title: Youth cultural participation: social and cultural influences
descriptions: This study on the active and receptive cultural participation of adolescents of different ethnic backgrounds in relation to that of their parents and best friend is based on a survey (2002) among 864 respondents in the city of Utrecht (698) and Tilburg (166).
The dataset follows the questionnaire. The missings of some variables may be interpreted as 'no'.

relations.text: Wel, F., van, Couwenbergh-Soeterboek, N., Couwenbergh, C., Bogt, T. ter, & Raaijmakers, Q. (2006). Ethnicity, youth cultural participation, and cultural reproduction in the Netherlands. Poetics, 33, 65-82.

data_sources: The respondents were pupils from 42 classes at six comprehensive secondary school (five schools were situated in the city of Utrecht; one in Tilburg).
